items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
items.claim: God spoke to Moses with a commandment

items.quote: In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation
items.claim: The children of Israel shall observe a sabbath with trumpet-blowing on the first day of the seventh month
items.object: a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation
